phase.text: Registrational efficacy trial (WU-KONG1 Part B); the confirmatory trial WU-KONG28 is the phase 3 study

citations.quote: the primary efficacy and safety data supporting the proposed indication was derived from the WU-KONG1/DZ2019E001, Part B clinical trial.

In addition, a phase 3 study (WU-KONG28, NCT05668988) is ongoing to confirm clinical benefit by evaluating the efficacy and safety of sunvozertinib monotherapy, as compared with carboplatin-pemetrexed chemotherapy, in the first-line treatment of NSCLC patients with EGFR exon20ins.
The efficacy of ZEGFROVY was evaluated in WU-KONG1B (NCT03974022), a multinational, open-label, dose randomization clinical trial.

population.text: Adults with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations whose disease progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy, ECOG 0 or 1

citations.quote: Eligible patients had locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations with disease progression on or after platinum-based chemotherapy and Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) of score 0 or 1.

endpoint.text: Overall response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1 by blinded independent review committee; duration of response (DOR) an additional measure

citations.quote: The major efficacy outcome measure was overall response rate (ORR) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST v 1.1) as evaluated by a blinded independent review committee (BIRC). An additional efficacy outcome measure was duration of response (DOR) by BIRC.

n.text: 85 patients randomized to ZEGFROVY 200 mg (efficacy population)

citations.quote: Patients with measurable disease at baseline were randomized to receive either ZEGFROVY 200 mg (n=85) or ZEGFROVY at an unapproved dose orally once daily with food until disease progression or intolerable toxicity.

result.text: ORR 46% (95% CI: 35, 57) at 200 mg; median DOR 11.1 months (95% CI: 8.2, NE); 72% of responders had DOR ≥6 months

citations.quote: Overall Response Rate (ORR), % (95% CIa)	46 (35, 57)
Medianb, months (95% CI)	11.1 (8.2, NE)
Patients with DOR ≥6 months	72%

indication.text: Treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy

citations.quote: ZEGFROVY is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 20 insertion mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test [see *Dosage and Administration* (2.1)], whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy.

target_moa.text: Orally bioavailable EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor that binds to and inhibits EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations and inhibits phosphorylation in cells expressing these mutations

citations.quote: Sunvozertinib is an orally bioavailable kinase inhibitor that inhibits epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) that binds to and inhibits EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations. Sunvozertinib inhibits phosphorylation in cells expressing EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations.
Sunvozertinib (DZ9008) is an oral small molecule inhibitor of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) that demonstrates activity against EGFR exon 20 insertion (exon20ins) mutations.

key_safety.text: Most common (≥20%) adverse reactions were diarrhea, rash, decreased appetite, stomatitis, fatigue, nausea. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 41%; fatal adverse reactions in 2.2%. Diarrhea occurred in 73% (2.5% Grade 3); ILD/pneumonitis in 1.7%.

citations.quote: The most common (\ge 20\%) adverse reactions were: diarrhea, rash, decreased appetite, stomatitis, fatigue, nausea, paronychia, vomiting, constipation, musculoskeletal pain, pruritus, dry skin, urinary tract infection, abdominal pain and decreased weight. (6.1)

Serious adverse reactions occurred in 41% of patients who received ZEGFROVY. Serious adverse reactions in \ge 2\% of patients who received ZEGFROVY were pneumonia (9%); dyspnea (4.4%); and pancreatitis, device related infection and rash (2.2% each). Fatal adverse reactions occurred in 2.2% of patients who received ZEGFROVY including thrombosis (1.1%) and COVID-19 infection (1.1%).
Diarrhea occurred in 73% of patients who received ZEGFROVY, including 2.5% Grade 3.
ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 1.7% of patients.

detail.text: Life Technologies Corporation Oncomine Dx Express Test approved as a companion diagnostic to detect EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations

citations.quote: It was determined that the data submitted in the PMA are supportive of approval of the ODxET as a companion diagnostic device to identify patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring *EGFR* exon 20 insertion mutations, whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy, and who may be eligible for treatment with ZEGFROVY (sunvozertinib).

surrogate_endpoint.text: Overall response rate and duration of response (intermediate clinical endpoints reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit)

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate and duration of response [see *Clinical Studies* (14)].

While confirmed durable response of an appropriate magnitude can support an Accelerated Approval, FDA does not consider these endpoints as surrogate endpoints, but rather as intermediate clinical endpoints that are reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit and as such require a confirmatory pivotal trial to verify this benefit.
